## Result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Closes #<issue>

## Validation

List relevant checks and results, including checks not run.

## Risk and security

Describe behavior changes, ownership, security impact, and remaining decisions.

Ordinary PRs target develop with an issue-free title; set the squash commit title
to `#<issue> <type>(<scope>): <description>`. For a promotion or an explicitly
configured maintenance exception, remove the closing-reference placeholder and
follow [repository setup](../docs/repository.md).
